INTRODUCTION
GRAH Intensity shows how strongly each GRAH is
activated at a given time, not whether the result is
Favourable or Unfavourable. Read it together with GRAH
Vibes to understand both the intensity and the direction.
If exact time
available
VERY HIGH
If birth time is
approx. ±1 hrs
HIGH
If birth time is
unavailable
MODERATE
CK Trajectory
Client Details
Important:
A higher Intensity zone does not automatically mean a better result. It only
means that the GRAH is more strongly activated. Read with GRAH Vibes for
favourable or unfavourable
GRAH Trigger shows how strongly a particular GRAH is activated at a given time. It
does not show whether the result is Favourable or Unfavourable. Trigger is given daily,
laid out in a monthly view across the year. All 9 GRAHs are shown in its own chart.

•Blueprint: Your fixed CosmoKundli pattern.

•Planner Plus and Planner Max: Sentiment, Situation and additional 5D
